sentences.text: What if you fell into the open ocean above the Mariana Trench without any equipment?
You quickly start sinking into the open ocean without any breathing gear.
Within 200 metres, natural sunlight begins to fade away completely.
Past 1,000 metres down, complete pitch darkness surrounds your body.
The growing water pressure squeezes all air spaces inside you flat.
Your body continues sinking for several hours through near freezing water.
At nearly 11,000 metres down, you reach the quiet seafloor.
The surrounding water exerts over 1,000 times standard surface pressure.
You drown in minutes near the surface while water pressure flattens your lungs.
It takes hours to reach the bottom in total darkness nearly 11,000 metres down.
The deep ocean remains one of Earth's least explored areas.

title: What Happens If You Fall Into the Mariana Trench?
